{{Quote|Utterly implacable, the huge machines raised their weapons toward the collected civilians and sprayed them with jets of glistening steam. The cries of protest died immediately. Even before the vapors cleared, leaving a collection of frozen statues that had once been normal village folk, the droids rampaged through the village. No living thing survived.|Excerpt from ''Imperial Atrocities and Other Noble Pursuits|<ref name="CWD">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' [[Carbonite war droid]] databank entry ([[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]])</ref>}}
'''''Imperial Atrocities and Other Noble Pursuits''''' was a narrative work written by the military [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Chen Ming-di]]. The document depicted many brutal military successes by the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during its rise to power and subsequent reign.

One portion of the document narrates the subjugation of the [[City/Legends|village]] of [[Rhador]],<ref name="CWD" /> while another depicts 85 [[Jumptrooper/Legends|Imperial jumptroopers]] forcing the surrender of over 3,000 [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] while [[Battle of Ebenmal|capturing]] the [[Citadel of Ebenmal]].<ref name="IJT">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' [[Jumptrooper/Legends|jumptrooper]] databank entry ([[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]])</ref>
